mentions.name: Amazon Ordering Telegram Bot
mentions.description: A Telegram bot that accepts an address and a list of Amazon links, orders the items (at a discount via the author's Amazon credit card), and adds the purchase to the "family debts" spreadsheet, enabling programmable, trusted lending among a trusted group.
mentions.problem: Manually ordering items for family members and recording who owes whom money.
mentions.audience: Trusted family group who order items for each other and track who owes what
mentions.source_excerpt: Om Friday after Thanksgiving I spent half a day building a telegram bot that accepts an address and a list of Amazon links, and in turn orders the item (at a discount since it uses my Amazon credit card), and adds it to the above "family debts" spreadsheet.

evidence.value: Om Friday after Thanksgiving I spent half a day building a telegram bot that accepts an address and a list of Amazon links, and in turn orders the item (at a discount since it uses my Amazon credit card), and adds it to the above "family debts" spreadsheet.
